art.knownLimit: The existing cyan/magenta contour fringe remains. No new extraction, alpha threshold, image recoloring or contour cleanup is claimed.

integration.movement: Final horizontal displacement after all existing updateEnemy wrappers; private travel advances by accepted distance, 7.2 world pixels per walking cell. Rollbacks, blocked motion, zero steps and invalid relocations cannot supply a native walking distance.
integration.contact: Only a finite positive return from the existing damagePlayer call marks contact. The catalogue attack-hit event is not imported and no gameplay event is emitted by the art.
integration.cueLifecycle: Private WeakMap cue aged immediately after the native actor clock, before AI early returns; 0.3 seconds total, draw-only reads, no independent RAF, expiry also off screen.
integration.resume: Successful resume creates a new actor without private movement or contact memory; native windup and corpse age survive. A rejected resume retains the prior owner.
integration.loading: Entry and successful resume request the one exact same-origin atlas. Missing, wrong-sized, incomplete or foreign sources retain the native vector body. Adult Queen and guard readiness are independent.
integration.warning: Guard ellipse only; no seven-point adult Queen warning is added.
integration.reducedMotion: Idle cell0 and walking cell4; native anticipation, accepted contact, recovery and death remain legible.
integration.culling: Conservative whole-cell union across16 poses and both facings, admitted only for a ready current owner; does not modify physical collisions or melee range.
